input.cost_contract: pnl and pnl_pct_equity are taken from the saved next-open run with 6 bps fee and 2 bps slippage per side

blocked_bins.funding_relative: PIT per-symbol funding interval and settlement timestamp are not present in the saved ledger
blocked_bins.regime: causal regime label is not present in the saved ledger

primary_filter.test: deterministic one-sided sign-flip test for negative mean pnl_pct_equity
primary_filter.selection_order: lowest q then most negative discovery mean

fail_closed_rules: No selected discovery hours means FAIL, not threshold relaxation
Validation or holdout failure means FAIL and no live env change
Missing funding-relative and regime inputs are reported, not reconstructed from future data
No parameter or live risk mutation is authorized
